title: A clearer night roster
summary: Simplifies Night, Changes, Breaks, Actions and settings while keeping the working plan easy to scan.
changes: Consolidates open parts and allocation choices into one summary, with supporting overtime names on demand.
Compacts absence and overtime entry; recorded details remain under each nurse’s More menu and in Activity.
Shows break times beside their groups and makes full-night Pager break guidance explicit.
Replaces large Actions tiles with a readable list, simplifies roster name rows and removes repeated Chat availability labels.
Groups profile previews, photos and accent settings into expandable sections, and shortens the app guide.
Preserves unsaved profile fields when switching between Me and Our Shift.
